question: From among the following _______ learnt music from Swami Haridas for eleven years.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Tansen.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Tansen had learned music from Haridas for eleven years. 
 
• He became a great and famous singer.
 
• **Tansen** sang before **Emperor Akbar.** 
 
• **Akbar** was so impressed that he asked Tansen to join his court in** 1556.**
 
• **Tansen** became the favourite of the Emperor. Akbar used to visit Tansen’s house to hear him practise music.
 
• **Akbar** asked Tansen to sing whenever he had the mood. He also gave Tansen many presents. 
 
• Tansen was one of the **nine jewels** in Akbar's court. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tansen**, also remembered as **Miyan Tan Sen** or **Ramtanu Pande** was a prominent figure in Hindustani classical music. 
 
• Born in a Hindu brahmin family, he learnt and perfected his art in the northwest region of modern **Madhya Pradesh.**
 
• **Tansen Samaroh **or Tansen Sangeet Samaroh is celebrated every year in the month of December in Behat village of **Gwalior **district, Madhya Pradesh. It is a 4-day musical extravaganza. Artists and music lovers worldwide gather here to pay tribute to the Great Indian Musical **Maestro Tansen**.
